summary: First test run of Anil Sales Corporation MVP. Backend (18/18 pytest) and frontend critical flows all PASS. Auth, Products, Customers, POS Checkout (cash + credit), Orders status transitions, Payment recording, Invoice PDF, Dashboard summary and Analytics admin-gating verified end-to-end. Frontend Login -> Dashboard -> POS happy path produced ASC-prefixed invoice with stock decrement and InvoiceModal; Orders/Products/Customers/Analytics all render with seeded data.

issues: Recharts logs many 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial render (likely first paint inside flex container before layout). Not blocking; can be silenced by giving ResponsiveContainer a non-zero minHeight.
Radix DialogContent warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}`'. Minor a11y improvement only.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to InvoiceModal & other DialogContents to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) Set explicit minHeight on Recharts ResponsiveContainer to remove width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1121 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, products, customers, orders, analytics) for maintainability.
JWT_SECRET defaults to 'change-me' if env var missing — fine for preview but flag for production.
/api/orders/{oid}/invoice.pdf accepts token via query param — acceptable for direct download links but ensure HTTPS only in prod and short-lived tokens if exposed externally.
PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status has no role gating — any logged-in user (incl. employee) can change order status; consider restricting to admin or limiting allowed transitions.

DELETE /api/products and /api/customers are admin-only (good), but no soft-delete; deleting a product that has historical orders will leave dangling product_ids in orders (acceptable since order line items are denormalized, but worth a comment).
test_credentials: admin@anilsales.com / Admin@123, staff@anilsales.com / Staff@123 — both seed correctly on startup
seed_data_creation: No new seed data added by tests. Tests create transient TEST_ products and a credit order which is paid back to zero balance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all advertised endpoints. BASE_URL is read from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Tests are idempotent: they don't depend on test ordering aside from credit-checkout test which expects at least one customer (seed provides 3). Frontend sidebar uses label 'Point of Sale' (not 'POS') — use href '/pos' instead of text match.
